item.title: A high-resolution civil aviation emission dataset in China based on real-world flight trajectories
item.dc:title: A high-resolution civil aviation emission dataset in China based on real-world flight trajectories
item.dc:creator: Jinzi Wang Hengcai Zhang Peixiao Wang Zhoushun Han Jianing Yu Zhongyi Wang Feng Lu a Institute of Geographical Sciences and Natural Resources Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, Chinab State Key Laboratory of Resources and Environment Information System, Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, Chinac Key Laboratory of Regional Sustainable Development Modeling, Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, Chinad School of Water Conservancy and Environment, University of Jinan, Jinan, Chinae College of Resources and Environment, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, ChinaJinzi Wang is a Ph.D. student in Cartography and Geographic Information System at the State Key Laboratory of Geographic Information Science and Technology, the Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences. She obtained a master’s degree in Cartography and Geographic Information System from East China Normal University. Her research interests include the refined estimation of aviation emissions and emission reduction. Hengcai Zhang holds a Ph.D. and serves as an Associate Research Fellow at the State Key Laboratory of Geographic Information Science and Technology, Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research (IGSNRR), Chinese Academy of Sciences, with a research focus on stereoscopic spatiotemporal computing. Peixiao Wang is a Postdoctoral Fellow at the State Key Laboratory of Geographic Information Science and Technology, Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences. He received the Ph.D. degree from the State Key Laboratory of Information Engineering in Surveying, Mapping and Remote Sensing, Wuhan University, and received the M.S. degree from the Academy of Digital China, Fuzhou University. His research topics include spatiotemporal data mining and spatiotemporal prediction, especially focusing on spatiotemporal prediction of transportation systems. Zhoushun Han holds a master’s degree and is currently studying at the School of Water Conservancy and Environment, University of Jinan. His research interests include spatio-temporal data mining and three-dimensional spatio-temporal computing. Jianing Yu received the Bachelor’s degree in Geographic Information Science from Nanjing Normal University, in 2022. She is currently working toward the Ph.D. degree in Geographic Information Science at the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China. Her research interests include spatial-temporal data mining and 3D-Computing. Zhongyi Wang is currently a Master’s candidate at the State Key Laboratory of Geographic Information Science and Technology, Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research (IGSNRR), Chinese Academy of Sciences, specializing in spatiotemporal data mining. Feng Lu is a Professor at the Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences. His research interests cover trajectory data mining, computational transportation science and location-based services.
